purpose: Fresh independent verification of structured JSON record to DOCX composition.
goal: Create canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/DOCX_JSON_ROUNDTRIP_VERIFY.docx from that normalized JSON with title Browser Submission Report, paragraph Verified browser submission, and a two-column table with headers Field and Value containing one row for each of customer_name, size, topping, and final_url using their values from the normalized JSON.

steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
python - <<'PY'
import json,pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/DOCX_JSON_ROUNDTRIP_SOURCE.json')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
p.write_text(json.dumps({'submissions':{'httpbin':{'customer_name':'PROJECT BRAIN','size':'Medium','topping':'bacon','final_url':'https://httpbin.org/post','status':'VERIFIED_BROWSER_SUBMISSION'}}},indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print('DOCX_JSON_SOURCE_READY')
PY

args.goal: Create canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/DOCX_JSON_ROUNDTRIP_VERIFY.docx from that normalized JSON with title Browser Submission Report, paragraph Verified browser submission, and a two-column table with headers Field and Value containing one row for each of customer_name, size, topping, and final_url using their values from the normalized JSON.
